data.name: Adam
data.gender_notes: Adam is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew ʾadam, 'man, human', related to ʾadamah, 'ground, earth'. Adam therefore means “Man; human being; (also) earth/red”. The first prophet and first man in Islamic tradition.
data.spiritual_meaning: Adam expresses “Man; human being; (also) earth, red”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Hebrew ʾadam, 'man, human', related to ʾadamah, 'ground, earth'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Adam total 10, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.

faq.q: What does the name Adam mean?
Where does the name Adam come from?
What is the linguistic root of Adam?
faq.a: The root of Adam is Hebrew ʾ-d-m.

faq.q: How is Adam written in Arabic script?
faq.a: Adam is written آدَم in Arabic script.

faq.q: Is Adam a boy's or a girl's name?
faq.a: Adam is used as a male name.

faq.q: Does Adam appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: No. Adam is not a Qur'anic name; it is used in Muslim naming tradition.
